transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. To start off, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me?

Hi. Yeah, thanks for seeing me. Um, I guess what made me finally decide to come in is that, for the past few weeks, my eating has just been really off. 

Like, I'll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without even meaning to. And then I just kind of pick at dinner, even when my wife went to the trouble of cooking. I've actually noticed my jeans are starting to feel pretty loose, too, so... yeah, I figured I should probably get it checked out.
Over these past few weeks, have you been feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you'd normally enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Um... most days lately, I just wake up with this heavy, flat feeling. It's like the apartment is just too quiet, you know? And usually I'd play some music, but even picking up my guitar doesn't really lift me right now.
Did these feelings start around the same time as some particular stressful event or change in your life, like something happening at work, home, or with your health?

Yeah, I think so. Um... this current low stretch has been going on for about three weeks now. It pretty much started right after my wife settled into her new full-time work schedule. So, yeah, I guess that was a bit of a change at home that lines up with it.
Have you been having thoughts that you're worthless, or feeling excessively guilty about things, during this time?

No, not really. I mean, I don't feel worthless or anything like that. I just feel... flat. And I don't think I have anything to feel guilty about, so, no, no excessive guilt either. It's really just the lack of energy and the low mood.
Along with the low mood, have you noticed feeling unusually nervous, worried, or on edge during this time?
No, I wouldn't say I've been nervous or worried. I'm not really on edge. It's more just... like I said, just feeling really flat and tired. But no, no real anxiety or anything like that.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately—trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up much earlier than usual?

Yeah, I have noticed some changes there. I mean, I’m sleeping, but it’s pretty broken up. I keep waking up early, around four or five in the morning, and my mind just starts going... thinking about bills, or unfinished tracks I've been working on. And once I'm up, I can't really get back to sleep, so I just end up feeling tired before the day even starts.
Has this low mood and fatigue been affecting your ability to keep up with work, or your relationships and daily responsibilities?

Well, it's definitely having some impact. I mean, I'm still keeping up with the basic things around the house, like doing the dishes and taking out the trash. But... my music projects have completely stalled. I just can't seem to get anything done with them right now. And I've been missing chances to follow through with some musicians I had contacted earlier. I just don't have the drive to get back to them, so things are just kind of sitting there.
During this time, have you had any thoughts of death, or thoughts that you'd be better off not being alive?

No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I mean, I've been feeling down and unmotivated, but I haven't been thinking about death or wishing I wasn't here. It's just more of a heavy, tired feeling, not anything to do with wanting to hurt myself.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating or focusing on tasks, like reading, conversations, or work, during this time?

Yeah, I have. It's been really frustrating. Like, when I try to work on some code or arrange a song, I just can't seem to focus. I'll keep rereading the same line of code over and over, or I'll replay the same eight bars of music, and I just... I can't decide what to do next. It's like my brain just stalls out and I can't process it.
Have others noticed you moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or alternatively, do you feel restless and unable to sit still during this time?

I haven't really felt restless, no. But everything definitely feels slower right now. Like... I'll just sit with my laptop open for ages before I even move my hands to actually type or plug in the keyboard. It just takes a while to physically get going.
